about: Should Tex text back, or stay quiet (or only react)? The one judge's held-out cases (`textDecide.cjs`). Every chat, name and detail is invented (Dev2, 2026-11-12: never taken from a real chat), across kinds of groups (family, friends, a team, a club, roommates, a chat with an invented assistant called Nova or Atlas), and no case is within half its words of one of the judge's examples (`respond.test.mjs`). The mistakes found in real chats on 2026-11-11 to 11-12 are here rewritten (`from: "tune-up"`), so a later change can't bring them back. `want: hush` is quiet or a tapback; `want: reply` must reach the model. `must: true` is the owner's "@Tex must still work" set (2026-11-11): a tag, Tex's name as the one asked, a reply to Tex, or an answer to Tex's question; not one may be hushed. `setting` is a group's speak-up level (follow along when absent). "You" is Tex, a person is "@name"; "(replying to You)" or "(replying to @name)" says whose message a line was sent under, and "(your newest question)" marks Tex's latest question, as the Worker renders them (`events.ts`).
